$comment: The backend's own addresses, as the Desktop host pack emits them.
Written by nothing: asserted equal to the manifest by
backend's host-agent environment test. Two network perspectives share one
backend. WORKSPACE_CALLBACK_* is what a sandbox dials -- host.lemma.internal
resolves only inside guestd's containers. API_URL and its siblings are what
this Mac dials. A host agent given the first cannot resolve its server.
{base} is the install's base domain and {port} any port.
